settings.title: Settings
settings.nsfwBlurHint: Thumbnails stay blurred in the gallery until you open the media.
settings.hideNamesHint: Hide each media's name under its thumbnail in the gallery.
settings.channelStableHint: Recommended. Only tagged, fully released versions.
settings.channelBetaHint: Early access to new features - may be less stable.
settings.updateDowngradeWarning: This installs an older version than the one you're currently running - some data or settings introduced since then may not be readable until you switch back.
settings.updateDowngradeConfirm: Version {{version}} is older than what you have installed. Some data or settings introduced since then may not be readable until you switch back. Continue?
settings.sauceNaoApiKeyHint: Required for tag suggestions to work - SauceNAO no longer allows anonymous API access. Register a free account at saucenao.com and paste your key here.
settings.danbooruCredentialsHint: Optional - identifies tag-wiki lookups, tag autocomplete, and SauceNAO's Danbooru tag follow-ups with your own account instead of anonymously, which Danbooru's bot protection increasingly challenges.
settings.autoStartHint: Starts hidden in the system tray when you sign in.
settings.autoStartUnsupported: Not available in this build of the app.
settings.autoBackupHint: Saves a copy of the database and settings on a schedule, also while the app is in the tray. Restore them with "Import backup". Gallery preferences are only included in manual backups.
settings.autoBackupKeepHint: The oldest are deleted past the limit. No new copy is made if nothing changed since the last one.
settings.loggingHint: Records errors and key events to a local log file to help diagnose bugs. Off by default; the log is capped at about 10MB and never leaves your device unless you share it yourself. The log may include local file paths from your library.
settings.localTaggingHint: Downloads a small, self-contained AI model (~500MB) that runs entirely on this device to suggest tags for your images - nothing is uploaded anywhere. Uses Danbooru's tag vocabulary, the same one Danbooru tag descriptions (see the info icon next to tags) explain.
settings.localTaggingNsfwThresholdHint: How strict the local rating suggestion is - Danbooru's rating goes general < sensitive < questionable < explicit, so this picks where NSFW starts.
settings.localTaggingError: Could not set up local AI tagging: {{message}}
settings.backupHint: Export everything (library, tags, settings, preferences) into one file, or restore from a previous export. Importing replaces all current data.
settings.backupImportConfirm: This replaces your entire library and settings with the imported backup. Continue?
settings.backupImportedNeedsRestart: Backup imported. Restart the app to finish.
settings.extensionBridgeHint: Lets a companion browser extension save media directly into PiCollection. Disabled by default - nothing listens until you turn this on.
settings.extensionBridgeBackgroundMode: Keep PiCollection running in the background when the window is closed
settings.missingFilesHint: Check whether every media file can still be found at its saved path, and relink them in bulk if you moved or renamed a folder.
settings.missingFilesRelinkConfirm: This updates the saved path for every file under the old folder to the new one, not just the ones currently reported missing. Continue?
settings.missingFilesMoreHidden: +{{count}} more not shown - use the folder relink above for large batches.
settings.sourceFolderHint: Optionally pick one folder your media lives under. Files inside it are stored with a path relative to it, so moving the whole folder (new drive, reorganizing) only needs a settings change here instead of breaking every file.
settings.sourceFolderNone: No source folder configured - paths are stored as-is (absolute).
settings.sourceFolderPlanSummary: {{relocated}} files will be stored relative to this folder. {{warned}} files fall outside it and will use an absolute path.
settings.sourceFolderClearSummary: This clears the source folder. All {{warned}} media files will go back to using absolute paths.
settings.sourceFolderApplyConfirm: This changes how every affected file's path is stored. Continue?
settings.sourceFolderApplied: Done. {{relocated}} files now relative, {{warned}} left absolute.
settings.licensesHint: PiCollection is MIT-licensed and built on open-source software. The list of components and their licenses opens as a text file.

search.label: Search
search.placeholder: (a OR b) -c   — search tags, characters, series, artists and names
search.tooltip: A space means AND, OR means either, and a leading - excludes. Group with parentheses and quote terms with spaces. Example: (Zibai OR 兹白) (-suit -Zhongli). Terms match tags, characters, series, artists and media names.
